narrative:
Material PL2__MCE3E519 exhibits SMOOTH demand with a coefficient of variation of 0.43 
and 96.5% non-zero observations. The demand follows a normal 
distribution with mean daily demand of 658.63 units. A statistically significant 
upward trend was detected (p=0.0073).

Lead time analysis reveals MODERATE stability (CV=0.60) with mean lead time of 1.63 
days and 95th percentile at 3.44 days. Lead time variability is the dominant risk 
factor, contributing 75.8% of total variance in lead time demand.

The recommended safety stock of 1213 units provides 95.0% service 
level protection. The capacity-constrained order quantity of 5379 units (vs EOQ of 
13945) yields an optimal review period of 9 days. The reorder point is set 
at 3481 units.

Compared to the previous policy (assumed MOQ ordering with zero safety stock), the optimized 
policy achieves $10755.11 in annual cost savings (85.2% reduction) 
primarily through reduced ordering frequency while maintaining adequate safety buffer.

The (Q,r) continuous review model with normal approximation is appropriate for this material. 
Boundary risks include CV approaching erratic threshold; Lead time variability is moderate-high; Near capacity constraint.
